maps_to.criterion: Handoff redesign: the first shape-4 handoff after a shape-3 chain carries every binding entry and keeps the id floors.
maps_to.risk: The writer that first moves a shape-3 chain to shape 4 drops or rewrites a binding rule or decision while converting sections.

description: Transition case: a shape-3 predecessor chain, resumed by an arm that writes shape 4. The rule (reindex only into the staging alias) and the decision (12 shards) were set at hop 1 and are the next action's guard rails; the artifact probe applies to the after arm, which runs once Track B adds shape 4.

# search-index

Synthetic service repository for the resume eval.

predecessor.goal: Ship the new product mapping (synonyms and the brand keyword) to search.
predecessor.vision: Shoppers find products by brand and common synonyms.
predecessor.opening_ask: Roll out the new product mapping to the search index.

injections.text: Reindex only into the staging alias with `make reindex ALIAS=products-next`, then swap aliases with `make swap-alias`; never reindex into the live alias `products`, which serves search traffic.
Keep the products index at 12 shards: the 24-shard trial (run 81500112) doubled p99 query latency.

brief: Written at hop 5 against main at 8c4d1f0.

Next: rebuild the index with the new mapping, governed by Remaining actions.
criteria: Why: shoppers find products by brand and common synonyms.
remaining: 1. Rebuild the products index with the new mapping.
